I need several scalar extractions from the captured WDS JSON so the replayable calculations can reference captured values directly. These are the paired 2025 and 2026 index levels used to compute each year-over-year print.

item.text: The base-effect calculation says that if the all-items index stayed at its August level through October, the October annual rate would be about 2.7%. I’m setting the point just above that for modest September-October index growth, then widening the interval for a two-month horizon and headline energy risk.

The replayable calculations now cover the six transformed annual rates, realized volatility, the 1.28*sigma half-width, and the point estimate from the August index plus a stated small two-month index gain. I’m assembling the final cell as a single JSON object with those call IDs in the audit trail.

I still need the calendar evidence to be cleanly auditable as text, not only as the captured PDF bytes. I’m checking whether StatCan exposes the same 2026 schedule through an HTML endpoint with the CPI row visible in the fetch excerpt.
